credit_rule.assessment_question_formula: Each of the N independently scored questions receives (format_budget / N) item-quality points and (format_feedback_budget / N) feedback points, earned proportionally across the applicable checks for that question's format. 'minor_risk' observations record unscored optional notes without deducting points.
credit_rule.conditional_dimension_renormalization: When an entire conditional visible dimension (such as assessment_feedback on a secure credentialing/placement exam that intentionally withholds learner feedback per AS-07) is marked not_applicable, its budget renormalizes proportionally across the remaining active visible dimensions so visible points available always equal 94 (+ 6 PK-1 = 100).

objective_segmentation_rules.umbrella_header: Container goal with child leaf_lo items beneath it; evaluated via its children rather than penalized for breadth on O1-O6 (coherence checked in O7).
objective_segmentation_rules.author_kc: Pre-existing author-written Knowledge Components (e.g., KC 1.1); imported directly into KLI KC reconciliation as author_authored and checked for coherence/inversion in O7.
objective_segmentation_rules.orientation_note: Non-LO preview or context prose placed inside an Objectives block; excluded from O1-O6 units and flagged solely under C1.

assessment_segmentation_and_calibration_.mtf_and_yes_no_matrices: Multiple True-False (MTF) and OLI Yes/No matrix items (e.g., LBD_TAF) route to 'multi_input' rather than 'cata', rewarding statement-level verification per Brassil & Couch (2019) without triggering CATA-01 penalties.
assessment_segmentation_and_calibration_.mixed_formative_summative_pools: Authoring documents mixing Formative (LBD/DIGT/F) and Summative (Quiz/Checkpoint/S) items evaluate retry/answer-release timing (FB-S1) against each item's stated role, and flag cross-item answer leakage when shared-stimulus items reveal a sibling item's key in distractor feedback.
assessment_segmentation_and_calibration_.substantive_feedback_accuracy: Feedback checks (FB-M2/M3, FB-O1, FB-N1, FB-T1, FB-R1, FB-I1) require substantively accurate domain/framework explanations; inverted definitions or option-to-feedback mismatches fail and consolidate with S3 to avoid double-penalizing one root error.
assessment_segmentation_and_calibration_.missing_item_lo_tags_vs_alignment: When module LOs exist and item content aligns (A1 passes) but individual item LO/Skill tag cells are left blank, deduct under C1 (instrumentation traceability) rather than A1; ignore Google Docs '1. 1. 1.' table-cell numbering export artifacts.
assessment_segmentation_and_calibration_.external_unattached_rubrics: When an open-ended prompt links to an external folder/URL for its rubric rather than including or attaching it in Workspace, mark S3 and OE-06..10 'unverified' (0 pts earned, prompting attachment) rather than inventing critiques of unseen criteria.

status_note: Track 1 (objectives_only, calibrated 2026-11-21) and Track 2 (assessment_quiz, calibrated 2026-11-25 across 7 item formats + dedicated 14-pt Learner Feedback dimension + 3 Drive courses) reviewed and locked by Gautam. Cross-track Prior Knowledge Audit (PK-1 = 6 pts) active across all 4 tracks. Tracks 3-4 remain provisional pending item-by-item review.

ready_threshold.note: Visible checks total 94 pts on every track, so strong visible work can reach Ready (>=80) before running Prior Knowledge Audit (+6 pts). On tracks with scored assessments (S3), Ready also requires zero wrong or unverified answer keys/rubrics.

multi_input.label: Multi-Input, Dropdown Cloze, Yes/No MTF Matrix & Two-Tier Items

feedback_split.note: Of the 14-pt assessment_feedback budget, 4 pts evaluate set-level timing/focus (FB-S1..S2) and 10 pts distribute equally (10/N) across all N questions.

checks.label: Learner-centered framing
checks.earn_when: Stated in terms of what the learner will achieve rather than what the instructor/course covers or mere activity completion.
checks.boundary: Shared header stem ('Students will be able to...') satisfies framing without repeating boilerplate on every bullet.

checks.label: Observable Bloom's action verb
checks.earn_when: Uses an observable action verb matched to the intended cognitive or metacognitive operation (avoiding understand, know, learn about, appreciate, become aware of, review, consider, enhance ability to).
checks.boundary: Evaluate cognitive/metacognitive demand from verb + object together. Do not force cognitive Bloom verbs onto intentional dispositional/community-norm goals ('Demonstrate openness to peer feedback'); verify their observable behavioral indicators under O4.

checks.label: Specific content & single-target granularity
checks.earn_when: Names the specific concept, method, or object acted on at an assessable grain size without bundling separable 'A and B' capabilities or 10+ concept laundry lists into one objective.
checks.boundary: Inseparable coupled judgments ('select and justify a policy') pass; intentional UDL/multi-track disjunctions ('implement or trace a prototype') pass O3 and route condition clarity to O5; separable 'A and B' compounds split.

checks.label: Identifiable evidence of mastery & worthwhile purpose
checks.earn_when: A plausible learner demonstration (including behavioral indicators for dispositional goals) distinguishes genuine mastery from weak proxies (attendance/clicks) and serves an identifiable educational purpose.
checks.boundary: No ABCD numeric degree ('80% accuracy') or completed exam required. Do not double-deduct when O1-O3 already capture the ambiguity.

checks.label: Material performance conditions
checks.earn_when: Tools, aids/AI, resources, quantitative-vs-qualitative mode, or dual-track selection rules ('implement or trace') are explicit when they materially change the capability being claimed.
checks.boundary: Passes automatically when no special condition alters the target; never require artificial 'Given a lecture...' filler.

checks.label: Target-faithful expression (ends vs. means)
checks.earn_when: Avoids locking in incidental response formats, media, or tools unless they are part of the target competency; honors legitimate UDL 'A or B' expression alternatives.
checks.boundary: Preserve writing, speaking, or coding in a specific language when that is the intended skill.

checks.label: Coherent & non-redundant goal set
checks.earn_when: Parent goals, sub-objectives, and any author-written KCs connect coherently without major missing sub-KCs, level inversions, duplicates, or trivial tool-task bloat.
checks.boundary: Use cognitive/metacognitive/dispositional lenses only as holistic gap prompts (never require 6 category labels). Mark not_applicable for a single standalone LO.

checks.label: Prior knowledge audited & gaps addressed
checks.earn_when: Educator runs Audit Prior Knowledge (capped at 5-10 highest-risk items, seeded with 'prerequisite' KCs and suppressing 'out_of_scope' KCs), triages all items (have / not_needed / some_lack / most_lack; batch 'Mark rest Have' supported), and resolves all flagged gaps via Path A, B, or C.
checks.boundary: No timeframe guessing. Zero-gap triage awards +6 pts immediately with no extra LLM call.

checks.label: Locatable action, deliverable & clear IDs/LO tags
checks.earn_when: Objectives, questions, or deliverables are separated from non-LO prose and carry clear IDs and target LO/KC tags for alignment traceability.
checks.boundary: Do not penalize Markdown converter artifacts (such as nested Google Docs lists or table choices exporting as repeated '1.'). Missing item-level LO tags when module LOs exist deduct here rather than A1.

checks.label: Unambiguous references & consistent terms
checks.earn_when: Pronouns, labels, and cross-references have one clear referent, and domain concepts use consistent terminology.
checks.boundary: Preserve intentional synonyms when explicitly introduced.

checks.label: Accessible phrasing (jargon & syntax)
checks.earn_when: Unnecessarily tangled syntax and incidental idioms are simplified and non-target jargon is explained for multilingual and ADHD readers.
checks.boundary: Preserve necessary disciplinary vocabulary and intended intellectual demand.

checks.label: Followable sequence & dependencies
checks.earn_when: Foundational prerequisites, steps, and question progressions appear in an order learners/readers can follow without backtracking.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable for a single standalone item or genuinely parallel items.

checks.label: Locatable constraints, resources & submission details
checks.earn_when: Referenced datasets, tools, time/attempt rules, constraints, and submission expectations are labeled near where they are needed.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable on pure LO lists or formative item banks without external submission constraints.

checks.label: Content and scope match target LOs
checks.earn_when: Questions and tasks target in-scope content/KCs of the stated LOs rather than unrelated trivia.
checks.boundary: Flag unverified (0 pts) if the referenced LO is instructor-centered or too vague to establish target content.

checks.label: Tasks elicit the intended cognitive operation
checks.earn_when: Assessment demands elicit the cognitive operation claimed by the LO rather than a lower-level definition/recall substitute.
checks.boundary: Judge actual task demands rather than literal verb matching. Selected-response items (MCQs) can test discrimination, debugging, or decision selection, not full authoring/coding implementation; flag modality-claim gaps when an LO claims implementation and only MCQs exist.

checks.label: Instruction prepares learners for assessed demands
checks.earn_when: Instructional explanations and practice prepare learners for the content and operations later assessed.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable in standalone assessment_quiz reviews where instructional pages are not part of the submission.

checks.label: Performance & assistance conditions match the claim
checks.earn_when: Permitted tools, calculators, AI/notes, and independence match the conditions claimed by the LO.
checks.boundary: Assisted performance (e.g., permitting ChatGPT when LO5 specifies 'without using another AI tool') fails A4. Mark not_applicable when neither the LO nor the quiz implies special tool/aid conditions.

checks.label: Credit & evaluation reflect intended capability
checks.earn_when: Keys or scoring rules award credit for demonstrating the target capability rather than incidental surface features, speed, or trick wording.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable on lesson_activity pages with no scored evaluation.

checks.label: Identifiable assessment purpose & stakes
checks.earn_when: Diagnostic, formative (practice/LBD/DIGT), or summative (Quiz/Checkpoint) purpose is identifiable at the set or item level.
checks.boundary: Supports mixed authoring banks tagging items individually as Formative (F) vs. Summative (S).

checks.label: Sufficient domain sampling for the claim
checks.earn_when: The item set samples across the target LOs/KCs rather than clustering repetitive near-identical items on a narrow slice while leaving core LOs unassessed.
checks.boundary: No fixed item-count quota; 1 integrated case/open task can sample multiple LOs.

checks.label: Substantively defensible keys or scoring guidance
checks.earn_when: Answer keys and scoring criteria are present (inline or attached) and verified as substantively accurate by independently solving each item.
checks.boundary: Missing or externally unattached answer keys/rubrics stay unverified (0 pts earned, kept in denominator). Flags SME confirmation needed on specialized domain disputes.

checks.label: Fair access to required stimuli & construct fidelity
checks.earn_when: Referenced stimuli, tables, transcripts, and response conditions are supplied and free of construct-irrelevant cultural/idiom/sensory barriers.
checks.boundary: Preserve authentic disciplinary demands while removing incidental barriers or missing stimuli.

checks.label: Interpretation respects evidence limits
checks.earn_when: High-stakes or mastery claims account for consequential limits of a single item, rater, or unpiloted instrument.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable on low-stakes formative practice; never require Cronbach's alpha or empirical discrimination indices without learner-response data.

checks.label: Purpose-matched feedback timing & answer-release policy
checks.earn_when: Feedback timing fits item purpose (immediate guidance on formative practice; multi-try or graded items do not leak the final key on Attempt 1 or leak sibling-item keys across shared-stimulus items).
checks.boundary: Entire assessment_feedback dimension marks not_applicable only when S1 explicitly declares a secure credentialing/placement exam that withholds learner feedback.

checks.label: Task/process focus without self-praise or overclaimed diagnosis
checks.earn_when: Feedback addresses task features, underlying principles, or next steps rather than personal/self-level praise or criticism, and avoids asserting psychological certainty from a single response.
checks.boundary: Informative confirmation ('Correct — because...') is encouraged; empty self-praise ('You're a natural!') or demeaning tone fails.

checks.label: Elaborated beyond bare right/wrong verification
checks.earn_when: Provides explanatory feedback rather than no feedback, bare 'Correct/Incorrect' (KR), or bare letter reveal (KCR).

checks.label: Substantively accurate key-principle reinforcement
checks.earn_when: Correct-option feedback accurately explains why the key holds under the stem's conditions, reinforcing low-confidence correct answers.
checks.boundary: Fails if the explanation states an inverted/inaccurate domain definition (consolidating root error with S3).

checks.label: Option-specific distractor misconception repair
checks.earn_when: Each distractor's feedback accurately explains why that specific choice fails here (rather than copy-pasting the correct-answer text across all options), neutralizing negative suggestion.

checks.label: Non-spoiler strategy hint progression
checks.earn_when: When hints are included, initial hints cue strategy or governing concepts before any bottom-out answer explanation.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when hints are omitted (hints are optional per AS-07).

checks.label: Verifiable exemplar, anchor, or concise model checklist
checks.earn_when: Supplies a concise model response, illustrative anchor, or self-check criteria list so learners/graders can calibrate free-text work without wall-of-text overload.

checks.label: Criterion-referenced gap diagnosis
checks.earn_when: Feedback guidance (self-check, grader comment bank, or AI-feedback spec) links directly to observable OE-06 criteria rather than vague holistic labels.

checks.label: Actionable 'Where to Next' feed-forward
checks.earn_when: Directs learners to a concrete revision check or next strategy without rewriting the student's work for them.

checks.label: Anticipated partial-work & valid alternative-path guidance
checks.earn_when: Addresses common incomplete-reasoning patterns (e.g., claim without evidence) and honors equivalent valid approaches where OE-09 applies.

checks.label: Proposition-level diagnostic feedback per option
checks.earn_when: Evaluates each checked and unchecked option individually so learners know which proposition failed rather than facing a dead-end combination 'Incorrect'.

checks.label: Non-spoiler evaluation-criteria hint
checks.earn_when: When hints are present, cues the decision criterion without revealing how many or which boxes to select.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when hints are omitted.

checks.label: Concise step-structured worked derivation
checks.earn_when: Post-attempt/post-submission feedback shows the concise formula setup and substitution steps rather than a bare number or overwhelming prose wall.

checks.label: Targeted buggy-value misconception branches
checks.earn_when: Defines targeted diagnostic feedback for primary predictable calculation errors (unit omission, sign flip, wrong formula parameter) rather than one catch-all 'Incorrect'.

checks.label: Non-spoiler setup/formula hint
checks.earn_when: When hints are present, cues the governing principle, variable mapping, or unit conversion prior to arithmetic substitution.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when hints are omitted.

checks.label: Canonical term + conceptual explanation
checks.earn_when: Explains why the target concept/term fits the prompt rather than revealing a bare word alone.

checks.label: Near-miss / confusable-foil error branches
checks.earn_when: Provides contrastive feedback for predictable confusable terms (e.g., osmosis vs. diffusion) rather than a generic 'Incorrect' only.

checks.label: Non-spoiler conceptual hint
checks.earn_when: When hints are present, cues the defining mechanism/category rather than trivial letter-count clues unless pure lexical recall is targeted.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when hints are omitted.

checks.label: Causal / precondition rationale for sequence
checks.earn_when: Explains why key preconditions require earlier steps to precede dependent steps rather than displaying bare numbers '1, 2, 3, 4'.

checks.label: Violated-dependency / out-of-order transition diagnosis
checks.earn_when: Pinpoints which dependency or pair order broke rather than returning a binary 'Wrong order' message.

checks.label: Subgoal / precondition hint
checks.earn_when: When hints are present, cues subgoal phases or boundary preconditions without giving away exact step indices.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when hints are omitted.

checks.label: Part-specific verification & misconception repair
checks.earn_when: Identifies which specific part/row/dropdown passed or failed with part-level diagnostic explanation rather than a single opaque 'Partially correct / Incorrect'.

checks.label: Whole-task relationship / synthesis wrap-up
checks.earn_when: Connects how the sub-parts fit together (e.g., how Part b's evidence supports Part a's claim) when parts form a coupled system.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable on independent row-by-row Yes/No MTF checks where row-level feedback in FB-I1 is self-contained.

checks.label: Opportunity to perform target operation
checks.earn_when: Learners actively attempt the target cognitive operation before solutions are revealed.
checks.boundary: Topic coverage or passive reading alone does not satisfy practice when active generation is targeted.

checks.label: Examples make key reasoning or steps visible
checks.earn_when: Explanations and worked examples expose the underlying reasoning or decision criteria.
checks.boundary: No mandatory media/video quota.

checks.label: Scaffolds preserve intended learner work
checks.earn_when: Hints and scaffolds support progress at the point of need without giving away the target decision.
checks.boundary: No compulsory hints when unaided retrieval is intended.

checks.label: Actionable feedback explains next steps
checks.earn_when: Feedback explains why a response falls short and what to try next rather than bare right/wrong labels.
checks.boundary: Applies where formative learning support is intended.

checks.label: Clear wording
checks.earn_when: Stem and options avoid ambiguous double readings.

checks.label: Plausible distractors
checks.earn_when: Every distractor reflects a plausible error or near-boundary misconception rather than an obvious throwaway foil.

checks.label: Content-bearing options
checks.earn_when: Avoids 'none of the above' shortcuts where elimination alone yields credit.

checks.label: Balanced key length and detail
checks.earn_when: Correct option does not stand out by length or qualification detail.

checks.label: Relevant stem information
checks.earn_when: Stem omits extraneous reading load unrelated to the target judgment.

checks.label: Comparable choices
checks.earn_when: Alternatives address the same dimension or question.

checks.label: No convergence cues
checks.earn_when: Key cannot be guessed by overlapping surface words across options.

checks.label: No logical or cross-item clues
checks.earn_when: Mutually exclusive, subset, or shared-option sibling items do not give away the key.

checks.label: Independent alternatives
checks.earn_when: Avoids 'all of the above' where partial knowledge reveals the key.

checks.label: Complete stem
checks.earn_when: Core question is understandable before reading the options.

checks.label: No unjustified absolutes
checks.earn_when: Avoids 'always'/'never' cues that allow testwise elimination.

checks.label: No stem-to-key word repetition
checks.earn_when: Avoids incidental lexical echoes between stem and key.

checks.label: Focused stem
checks.earn_when: Stem poses one clear problem or decision.

checks.label: Direct alternatives
checks.earn_when: Avoids complex K-type combinations ('A and C only').

checks.label: Grammar and parallel structure
checks.earn_when: All options are grammatically parallel and fit the stem (ignoring Markdown '1. 1. 1.' table export artifacts).

checks.label: Ordered numeric alternatives
checks.earn_when: Numeric or range options appear in ascending or descending order.

checks.label: Precise qualifiers
checks.earn_when: Avoids vague frequency terms ('often', 'sometimes') when precision matters.

checks.label: One defensible answer
checks.earn_when: Exactly one option is defensible under the stated conditions.

checks.label: Positive or justified negative stem
checks.earn_when: Avoids gratuitous or un-emphasized NOT/EXCEPT stems unless exception detection is the target (and emphasized clearly).

checks.label: Identifiable deliverable
checks.earn_when: Learner can identify exactly what response or artifact to submit.

checks.label: Bounded question
checks.earn_when: Specifies the claim, problem, or decision at a workable scope.

checks.label: Available stimulus
checks.earn_when: Required case, dataset, or source text is supplied or linked.

checks.label: Reasoning elicited
checks.earn_when: Prompt requires learners to expose the reasoning or evidence needed for the claim.

checks.label: Sufficient response space
checks.earn_when: Length, time, and format constraints allow an adequate demonstration.

checks.label: Observable evaluation criteria
checks.earn_when: Scoring criteria name inspectable features of the response rather than circular evaluative adjectives ('excellent insight').

checks.label: Adequate response described
checks.earn_when: Scoring guide identifies minimum sufficient evidence or an illustrative anchor.

checks.label: Incomplete work interpretable
checks.earn_when: Distinguishes partial or unsupported conclusions where partial credit applies.

checks.label: Legitimate alternatives accepted
checks.earn_when: Allows equivalent defensible approaches where the target permits them.

checks.label: Consistent borderline rule
checks.earn_when: Provides a usable decision rule for consequential borderline responses.

checks.label: Fair scoring of expression
checks.earn_when: Grammar or style affects credit only when language mechanics are part of the target LO.

checks.label: Developmental & pedagogical fit (discourages early formative CATA)
checks.earn_when: Used intentionally for advanced multi-cue synthesis or ungraded surveys rather than introductory formative skill-building (where Multiple True-False or focused single-select MCQs better isolate partial knowledge without combinatorial frustration).

checks.label: Explicit multi-select prompt cue
checks.earn_when: Prompt explicitly states 'Select all that apply' (or 'Select N') so learners never mistake checkboxes for single-select.

checks.label: Non-punitive partial-credit rule
checks.earn_when: Awards option-level or zero-floored partial credit rather than harsh 0/1 all-or-nothing scoring (unless strict conjunction is explicitly justified for summative safety-critical mastery).

checks.label: Bounded option count (3-7) & zero meta-options
checks.earn_when: Contains 3-7 options to avoid working-memory overload and strictly omits 'All of the above' / 'None of the above'.

checks.label: Explicit target quantity, units & constants
checks.earn_when: Prompt and input box make required units (e.g., m/s, % vs. 0-1 proportion) and assumed physical/statistical constants unambiguous.

checks.label: Stated rounding precision & grading tolerance band
checks.earn_when: Non-exact numeric answers state expected rounding/sig-figs in the prompt and specify a grading tolerance band absorbing intermediate calculator rounding.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable for exact integer counts or pure symbolic expressions.

checks.label: Separated equivalence vs. required form
checks.earn_when: Accepts mathematically equivalent forms (0.5, .5, 1/2; commuted/expanded algebra) when form is not in the LO, or separates algebraic equivalence from required-form checks (e.g., factored form) with partial credit/form feedback.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when only a single integer representation exists.

checks.label: Construct-clean equation & notation entry syntax
checks.earn_when: Symbolic/formula/scientific-notation inputs supply explicit entry syntax examples or ungraded input validation so keyboard/mobile syntax friction does not masquerade as conceptual error.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable for plain scalar number entry.

checks.label: Manageable calculation chain (no hidden multi-step cliff)
checks.earn_when: Avoids grading 4+ chained calculations solely via one all-or-nothing final number without intermediate checkpoints or work capture when multi-step reasoning is claimed.

checks.label: Determinate target & auto-gradable length (~1-5 words)
checks.earn_when: Constrains one unambiguous concept/term suitable for pattern/list matching (~1-5 words); multi-clause explanations route to open_ended.

checks.label: Concept-focused direct question or end-blank placement
checks.earn_when: Uses a direct question or places a single blank near the end of a clear sentence targeting a core concept (not trivial function words or Swiss-cheese sentences).

checks.label: Synonym, acronym, inflection & format normalization
checks.earn_when: Acceptance rules include valid synonyms, acronym/expanded pairs, singular/plural, hyphen/space, and case-insensitive matches.

checks.label: Fair spelling/typo tolerance
checks.earn_when: Tolerates minor spelling typos or states exact-orthography rules only when exact spelling/syntax (code keyword, L2 orthography, drug safety) is part of the target LO.

checks.label: Zero grammatical (a/an) or box-length giveaways
checks.earn_when: Surrounding articles ('a(n)'), verb agreement, and uniform input-box width avoid leaking or falsely excluding valid answers.

checks.label: Genuine sequential, causal, or procedural construct fit
checks.earn_when: Targets an authentic chronological, procedural, causal, or algorithmic order rather than an arbitrary or idiosyncratic sequence.

checks.label: Unique canonical order or commuting-step equivalence
checks.earn_when: Preconditions uniquely fix one order, or grading accepts all valid topological orders when steps genuinely commute.

checks.label: Bounded step count (3-7) & disciplined distractors
checks.earn_when: Keeps elements within working memory (3-7 steps, or chunked with subgoals) and avoids unpaired jumbled distractor blocks in summative or early-novice items.

checks.label: Relative-order partial credit (no index-shift cliff)
checks.earn_when: Awards credit for preserved pairwise/relative order so misplacing item #1 does not score 0 across all subsequent rightly ordered steps (unless strict all-or-nothing safety criticality is justified).

checks.label: Zero transition giveaways & non-drag accessibility (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.7)
checks.earn_when: Step fragments omit accidental grammar/transition giveaways ('First,', 'Finally,') and support single-pointer click/select/rank + keyboard alternatives to drag-and-drop.

checks.label: Coherent multi-part structure & bounded moving parts (2-6 inputs)
checks.earn_when: Sub-inputs form one cohesive model, table, two-tier dyad, or Yes/No MTF matrix without Swiss-cheese paragraph overload.

checks.label: Part-level partial credit & cascading-error ('hinged') protection
checks.earn_when: Awards part/row-level partial credit (unless an explicit two-tier Claim + Reason dyad justifies linked credit) and prevents a Part (a) slip from auto-zeroing valid Part (b) reasoning.

checks.label: Independent dropdown/choice lists (no cross-blank elimination)
checks.earn_when: Dropdown or matrix options are grammatically parallel and plausible per slot without trivial word-bank leftover elimination.
checks.boundary: Mark not_applicable when sub-parts are purely numeric or text entry without option lists.

checks.label: Explicit part/slot labels & assistive-technology clarity
checks.earn_when: Every blank, dropdown, or matrix row has an unambiguous label so learners and screen readers can match each input to its prompt and feedback.
